name: OpenAgentic Procurement & Commission Hub
description: A buyer-side agentic website. Type a commission in plain language: agents extract an RFQ, discover suppliers from their public agent manifests, request a quote with a 3D blueprint over window.postMessage, negotiate within your budget, and ask you to approve the order.

networks.name: procurement_hub
networks.description: Commission request -> RFQ -> supplier discovery -> quote negotiation -> approved order.

agents.name: intake_agent
agents.role: Natural-language commission -> structured RFQ (scale, theme, dimensions_cm, features, max_budget)

agents.name: discovery_agent
agents.role: Fetches supplier manifests, checks capabilities, picks a supplier

agents.name: negotiator_agent
agents.role: Requests the quote + 3D blueprint, counter-offers within budget, triggers human approval

tools.name: discover_suppliers
tools.description: Fetch and validate the agent manifests of registered suppliers (asks before contacting a new origin).

tools.name: request_supplier_quote
tools.description: Send the RFQ to a supplier's request_quote tool over postMessage RPC. Non-binding.

tools.name: send_counter_offer
tools.description: Send a counter-offer to the supplier's negotiate_quote tool. Non-binding.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Confirm the commission with the supplier (confirm_commission) and record the order. Never above the budget.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Read the orders placed from this hub.

rpc.consent: Every other origin is asked for once. place_order always pauses for approval on this site.

providers.label: Hybrid Auto: Nano local, Otari cloud fallback

llm.note: Visitors choose the provider. The Otari key stays on this origin; supplier sites run their own agents and never receive it.

peer_policy.outbound: consent per origin before the first contact
peer_policy.inbound: postMessage RPC with origin checks and consent
